title: LandRocker Game
fullDescription: A multiplayer space mining game that leverages a unique seed-based planet generator and voxel technology. The project required the integration of procedural generation systems and a physics-based rover controller to allow for unlimited, diggable planets. Players can explore, mine resources, build bases, and engage in multiplayer activities across the procedurally generated universe.

process.title: Concept & Design Phase
process.description: Initial game design document creation, concept art development, and core gameplay mechanics definition. The team worked on creating the central vision for a multiplayer space mining experience with unlimited exploration possibilities.

process.title: Procedural Generation System
process.description: Development of the seed-based planet generation system that creates limitless unique worlds with varying terrain, resources, and environments based on mathematical algorithms and noise functions.

process.title: Rover Physics Engine
process.description: Implementation of a custom physics-based rover controller that realistically interacts with the procedurally generated terrain, allowing for an immersive driving experience on different planetary surfaces.

process.title: Multiplayer Integration
process.description: Integration of Photon Fusion networking to enable seamless multiplayer experiences with up to 32 simultaneous players per server, including lag compensation and state synchronization systems.

process.title: Resource System & Economy
process.description: Development of the resource gathering, processing, and economy systems that form the core gameplay loop, allowing players to mine, refine, and trade various materials across the game universe.

process.title: Beta Testing & Optimization
process.description: Extensive beta testing phase with community feedback integration, performance optimization across various hardware configurations, and final balancing of game systems before launch.
